blocks.text: Cascade is a Japanese visual kei rock band, with a sound not typical of others in the movement, in that it is strongly influenced by new wave music. The band formed in 1993 and disbanded in August 2002, but six years later the band reunited and released a new album in 2009, Vivo.
Cascada is a German Eurodance music act founded in 2004 by singer Natalie Horler and composers/record producers DJ Manian and DJ Yanou.

images.alt: Cascada represented Germany in the Eurovision Song Contest 2013.
